card.line: Jabesh-gilead was a city east of the Jordan River. Its people were attacked by Israel, rescued by Saul, and later honored Saul by burying him.

moments.title: Judged for missing the gathering
moments.text: No one from Jabesh-gilead came to the assembly at Mizpah. Israel sent 12,000 men against the city, and four hundred young women who had not had relations with a man were brought to Shiloh and given to the Benjamites.

moments.title: Nahash lays siege
moments.text: Nahash the Ammonite surrounded the city. The elders asked for seven days to look for someone to save them, and sent messengers throughout Israel.

moments.title: Hope for deliverance
moments.text: Messengers brought word that help would come the next day. The men of Jabesh rejoiced and told Nahash they would come out to him the next day.

moments.title: Saul is buried
moments.text: The brave men of Jabesh-gilead traveled all night to take the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan. They burned them, buried the bones under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

moments.title: David thanks the city
moments.text: After the men of Judah anointed David king, they told him that the men of Jabesh-gilead had buried Saul. David sent messengers to ask the LORD to bless them for their kindness.
